challenge.description: The KPI definitions were never formally agreed, leaving the project without a clear target for success. #efficiency_emilia# wants the KPI definition to be fully automated and governed to ensure alignment with business goals, while #requirements_reuben# argues it should remain a manual process to allow for careful security and compliance review. #efficiency_emilia# is open to a compromise that keeps the process manual but documented, but #requirements_reuben# insists on strict manual control.

output.content: I have been reviewing the recent pipeline failures and the root cause is always the same. When the data contracts are manually adjusted, the ingestion pipeline breaks because it expects a specific schema. I need the data contracts to be fully automated. Every time we automate a contract, the integration becomes more seamless and the deployment frequency increases. I am not asking for a single fix. I want the entire contract generation process to be handled by the CI/CD tooling so that no human intervention is required during the build. The more automated the contracts are, the better the system performs under load. I am ready to invest the engineering time to build this out immediately.
output.reclassify_reason: The text explicitly states that the system performs better with more automation and that the author is ready to invest time immediately, indicating that doing more than the minimum fix (full automation) would make them happier.
